elements.name: question106
elements.html:
Protocol: PRA-216-201 (COPD)

Phase: 2a

 

Opening

Thank you for your interest in our clinical trials for COPD. As you may know, COPD is a chronic airway disease, defined as progressive loss of lung function and airflow obstruction, becoming one of the most important causes of death worldwide. This study seeks to assess a new medication designed by Prana Therapeutics, for its safety and effectiveness in treating COPD.

elements.name: question107
elements.html:
Study Drug and Design

This study’s drug is named ‘PRA-216’ and has been designed in a way that blocks inflammation pathways that define conditions such as severe asthma or atopic dermatitis. This will be administered as a subcutaneous injection at your abdomen, deltoid/shoulder or thigh, and participants will receive up to 4 doses.

 

This study drug will be compared against a placebo, and since this trial is double blinded, neither or nor the doctors will know which you have received until the end of the trial.

elements.name: question108
elements.html:
Study Duration

You can expect participation in this study to last up to about 9 months with a total of 16 in-clinic visits, segmented as follows: 

 

  • Screening period: Day -28 to Day -1
  • Dosing / Treatment Period: Day 1 to Day 85
  • Follow up: Day 86 to Day 281

 

You will have a total of 16 visits to our clinic, with your dosing days falling on:

 

  • Day 1 (Visit 2)
  • Day 15 (Visit 4)
  • Day 29 (Visit 5)
  • Day 85 (Visit 7)

 

Your intial consult will be a ‘pre-screening visit’, which will consist of FeNO testing and ensuring your COPD eligibility. This will take about half an hour to an hour.

elements.name: question110
elements.html:
Reimbursement

You will be reimbursed for any reasonable travel, parking, meals and other expenses associated with the study, broken down as $125 for your pre-screening visit, and $250 for each scheduled visit.

 

You will also undergo 2 CT scans, for which you will be reimbursed $105 for each of these.

 

You may be required to return to site for a repeated blood test, which you will be reimbursed at $105 for.

 

In the event that you are required to return to site for any other reason, you will be reimbursed $250 for any unscheduled visits.

 

If you attend each scheduled visit, you can be reimbursed up to a total of $4,085.

 

BREAKDOWN

  • $125 per pre-screening visit
    • 1 visit
  • $250 per clinic visit
    • 15 visits
  • $105 per CT scan 
    • 2 visits
  • Total: Up to $4,085

 

Additional

  • $105 for repeat bloods
  • $250 for unscheduled visits

elements.name: question111
elements.html:
Disclosure

 

Before we go any further, I want to explain exactly how the reimbursement works, so there are no surprises for you later. The reimbursement I just went through is what you'd receive if everything goes ahead as planned. That can look a bit different depending on what happens on the day. For example, if the doctor looks over your information early on and finds you're not eligible before we even get to the consent form, if you decide not to sign the consent form yourself, or if something doesn't line up with what you've told me today, you'd likely only get a partial amount, or in some cases nothing, instead of the full reimbursement.

 

That's actually a big part of why it matters that you're as accurate as possible with me right now. The doctor's early review is based on exactly what you tell me today, so the more accurate you are, the better your chances of making it all the way through screening and getting the full reimbursement.

elements.title: Before we wrap up, I’d like to share details about our referral program. If you refer someone to us you can receive up to $250 if they enrol and participate in the study. Would you like to hear more?

elements.name: question103
elements.html:
Great! Here's how it works:

 

To refer someone, you will need to provide them with a unique referral ID. The person you refer will need to provide us this ID either when they sign up on our website, or when they speak to us over the phone. This ID is essential, as it ensures we can track and reimburse you for any referrals.

 

For each person you refer who comes in for an in-person screening visit, you'll receive $50. If they go on to enrol and participate in the study, you'll earn an additional $200.

 

There's no limit- you can refer as many people as you'd like, as long as you have an exisiting relationship with them. It's important to note that you cannot advertise for referrals. This program is based on personal connections, so please only refer people you know.

 

If you're interested, we can set up your Unique Referral ID today if you would like (the unique referral ID is REF[p number]. E.g., REFP14471)

 

Who do you know you might be interested in this trial? (if they don't know anyone for this trial, they can also refer someone to any other trial)

 

Would you like us to send you an email that you can forward on to them?
